{"code":"def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 pts=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
 # identify 2 as hub; extrema of all points define box
 hub=next(((r,c) for r,c,v in pts if v==2),None)
 rs=[r for r,c,v in pts]; cs=[c for r,c,v in pts]
 top,bot=min(rs),max(rs); left,right=min(cs),max(cs)
 def color(r,c):
  return grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] else 5
 # boundaries use the original point on each extremal side (otherwise its color)
 for c in range(left,right+1):
  out[top][c]=grid[top][c] or 5; out[bot][c]=grid[bot][c] or 5
 for r in range(top,bot+1):
  out[r][left]=grid[r][left] or 5; out[r][right]=grid[r][right] or 5
 if hub:
  r,c=hub
  for x in range(min(c,right),max(c,right)+1): out[r][x]=grid[r][x] if grid[r][x] else 5
  for x in range(left,c+1) if c>=left else range(c,left+1): out[r][x]=grid[r][x] if grid[r][x] else 5
  for y in range(top,r+1): out[y][c]=grid[y][c] if grid[y][c] else 5
  for y in range(r,bot+1): out[y][c]=grid[y][c] if grid[y][c] else 5
 return out"}

 hr,_=hub

 for r in range(r0+1,r1):
